sloka: प्राप्तराज्यस्य रामस्य राक्षसानां वधे कृते ।आजग्मुर्ऋषयः सर्वे राघवं प्रतिनन्दितुम् ।। ७.१.१ ॥
transliteration: prāptarājyasya rāmasya rākṣasānāṁ vadhe kṛte ।ājagmurṛṣayaḥ sarve rāghavaṁ pratinanditum ।। 7.1.1 ॥

translations.english: After Rama had attained his kingdom and the destruction of the Rakshasas was accomplished, all the sages came to congratulate Raghava.
